name: Fulvous-dotted Treerunner
rangeDescription: Western andes of colombia and northwestern ecuador
description: A uniquely-marked little Furnariid. Very uncommon in restricted range on the west slope of the Andes in Colombia and Ecuador.

name: Black-casqued Hornbill
rangeDescription: Patchily distributed forest of western and central africa; bioko island
description: A gigantic black hornbill of African rainforests, often seen or heard in the canopy feeding on fruiting trees. Undertakes seasonal movements, and can be surprisingly common at certain times of year and absent in others.

name: Chinese Leaf Warbler
rangeDescription: Mountains of central china (sichuan, liaoning, and shanxi)
description: Small plump leaf warbler. A “Pallas’s-type” leaf warbler: stout, with a pale rump, crown stripe, and prominent brow stripes.

name: Wallace's Scops-Owl
rangeDescription: Lesser sundas (sumbawa and flores)
description: A large scops-owl restricted to Flores and Sumbawa. Grayish-brown overall.

name: Subtropical Doradito
rangeDescription: Andes of colombia to northwestern argentina (south to la rioja)
description: A bright flycatcher found in marshes in the Andes from Colombia to Argentina. Yellow below and olive above, sometimes showing a hint of a dark mask and dull yellowish edges on the wing feathers.

name: Blue Mountain Vireo
rangeDescription: Humid montane forest of northwestern jamaica
description: A stout, plain vireo of woodlands with dense foliage, preferring higher elevation and wetter forests. This species lacks facial markings or wingbars of other Caribbean vireos.

name: Tawny Lark
rangeDescription: Semiarid central plateau of india
description: A pale yellowish-brown lark with a long, spiky crest and a thick, short bill. The heavy streaking on the upperparts contrasts strongly with the rest of the plumage.

name: Bagobo Robin
rangeDescription: Southern philippines (montane forest of mindanao)
description: A seldom-seen medium-sized ground bird of foothill and montane forest on Mindanao. Rufous-brown above from the crown to the tail, gray below with a white throat and rufous from the lower belly to the base of the tail.

name: Orange Chat
rangeDescription: Interior of australia, to southern and western coasts
description: Brightly colored, terrestrial songbird found in open and arid regions across much of inland Australia. Male has rich bright orange head and underparts, with a dramatic throat that extends to the dark eye.
imageCreditName: Laurie Ross | Tracks Birding & Photography Tours

name: Olive-backed Quail-Dove
rangeDescription: Caribbean lowlands of costa rica to northwestern ecuador
description: Plump ground-dwelling dove, small for a quail-dove and much darker overall compared with the others. Overall dark grayish with contrasting white face and cheek.

name: Lesser Seedcracker
rangeDescription: Eastern tanzania to southern malawi, eastern zimbabwe, and northern mozambique
description: A colorful, chunky waxbill with a large conical bill. Both sexes have a red hood and tail, but females have slightly less extensive red.

name: White-tailed Alethe
rangeDescription: Senegambia to sierra leone, liberia, ghana, and togo
description: A forest skulker with clean-cut pale underparts, a gray wash on the side of the breast and face, and rusty brown upperparts and central crown. The tail has distinctive white tips to the outer feathers.

name: Solomons Monarch
rangeDescription: Bougainville, guadalcanal, choiseul, and santa isabel (northern solomon islands)
description: A small black-and-white monarch. White below except for black throat and breast.

name: Wallace's Fruit-Dove
rangeDescription: Southern moluccas including kai islands, and lowlands of southwestern new guinea, including aru islands (off southwestern new guinea)
description: A large fruit dove of forest on islands. Distinctive looking with gray neck and chest, dark red cap, and orange belly with white chest band.

name: Drakensberg Siskin
rangeDescription: Montane scrub of western kwazulu-natal and lesotho (drakensberg mountains)
description: A small, flighty, brown-lemon siskin of high-elevation grassland and shrubland above 2000 meters of elevation; partial to rocky outcrops. The lemon rump, visible in flight, and the white outer tail feathers most easily identify it.

name: Manus Brush Cuckoo
rangeDescription: Admiralty islands
description: Endemic to the Admiralty Islands off northeastern New Guinea (Manus being the largest of these islands), this smallish-medium cuckoo is the only one in its range. Light gray head and upper chest with buff-orange underparts.

name: Maned Duck
rangeDescription: Australia (except driest regions and far north), including tasmania
description: Small upright duck. Male is gray with a brown head, while the female is more heavily marked with pale marks on face.

name: Olive-backed Forest Robin
rangeDescription: Not well known, but reported in southwestern gabon south of the ogooué river and, in northeastern gabon, north of the ogooué river
description: Localized species found only in lowland rainforest south of the River Ogooué in Gabon, and possibly also in adjacent Congo. A short-tailed understory robin with a bright orange throat.

name: Swift Parrot
rangeDescription: Tasmania and flinders island; winters eastern and southeastern australia
description: Colorful migratory parrot with long red pointed tail. Breeds in Tasmania and migrates to southeastern Australia in autumn and winter.

name: Alor Myzomela
rangeDescription: Alor (lesser sundas)
description: A striking and little-known small honeyeater found only in the eucalyptus-dominated highlands of Alor, in the eastern Lesser Sundas. Unmistakable in its limited range; note bright red face and crown (brighter and more extensive in the male), pale belly, gray back, red rump, and slightly curved dark bill.
